news.contents: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (knee) is expected to miss 4-to-5 months of action after undergoing MCL surgery, Adam Schefter reports. Nacua is out for the rest of the season and is unlikely to return during the playoffs. Nacua may have taken his last snap with the team. He is in the final year of his rookie contract and is scheduled to be an unrestricted free agent in 2027. He'll finish this season with 70 receptions, 715 receiving yards and four touchdowns in seven games. The Rams ...

news.analysis: After scoring in three straight games, Hutchinson was disappointing for fantasy managers who hoped his hot streak would continue Thursday night. Hutchinson is consistently involved in the Texans' passing attack, but his ceiling is significantly limited in his current role. The fourth-year receiver has caught between 2 and 4 passes in all 10 games so far this season.
